title: Design Day #16 — Package Design
description:
The theme for February 2014's Design Day is:

PACKAGE DESIGN

The agenda includes:
1. A Design Story: By George Mathews - Founder: Icarus Design.

2. About Packaging Session: By Manasee Jog - Visiting Faculty, Srishti School of Media Arts

3. A JAM: You will be given a topic and would have to come up with some design suggestions based on that topic in 1.5 to 2 hours. This is a group activity, where participants are split into groups of 4-5 people. We will have markers, sketch pens and chart papers for your use.

Cheers,

Amit /Aashish
